# hestiacp_backup_host (Resource)

Configures a remote backup destination host in HestiaCP.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Hostname or IP of the backup server.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for authenticating to the backup server.
- `path` (String) Remote path where backups are stored.
- `port` (String) Port number of the backup server.
- `type` (String) Backup protocol: `ftp`, `sftp`, `b2`, `rclone`, etc.
- `username` (String) Username for authenticating to the backup server.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
